name: Bitter bamboo shoot
summary: Măng đắng is a fresh forest shoot with a light bitterness, eaten with a dipping sauce or stir-fried with forest pork. It is also on the Thai-Muong table at Thác Hiêu.
origin: Pù Luông and Thác Hiêu. Sources: the Vietnam Airlines travel guide; Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ, 12 Jul 2024.
howToEat: With a dipping sauce, or stir-fried with forest pork.
where: The valley meal, and Thác Hiêu in Bản Hiêu.
seoTitle: Bitter bamboo shoot in Pu Luong — dip or forest pork
seoDescription: Măng đắng is a slightly bitter fresh shoot, eaten with a dip or stir-fried with forest pork, in Pù Luông and at Thác Hiêu.
